cases.translation: The day turned out overcast and gloomy.
cases.explain: День is the subject of выдался (turned out), so nominative.

cases.sentence: Он вспомнил Володины руки над ___ с кипящей водой.
cases.translation: He remembered Volodya's hands over the vat of boiling water.
cases.explain: The preposition над (above/over) governs the instrumental case.
Пианино is an indeclinable noun borrowed from Italian, so it keeps the same form in every case, including after the preposition к (dative).

cases.translation: Yurka pulled a heavy pistol out of the desk.
cases.explain: Пистолет is the direct object of вынул (pulled out); being inanimate, its accusative matches the nominative form.

cases.translation: The Germans strengthened the guard of the facilities.
cases.explain: Охрана (guard/protection of something) takes a genitive complement.

cases.translation: Everything happened in the small storage closet.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: У Юрки не осталось ___ от волнения.
cases.translation: Yurka had no voice left from nervousness.
cases.explain: The negated construction не осталось (there was none left) requires the genitive.
The verb щёлкнуть (to click/snap) takes an instrumental complement — clicked 'with' the camera.

reading.ru: После этого разговора Володя совсем погрустнел и сказал, что руководить спектаклем поручает Юрке.
reading.question: Why did Volodya hand over control of the play to Yurka?
options: Olga Leonidovna insisted the counselors sit in the audience, not run the show
Volodya was too sick to continue
reading.correct: Olga Leonidovna insisted the counselors sit in the audience, not run the show
reading.explain: The senior counselor demanded that Volodya sit with her and the director in the hall instead of directing backstage.

reading.ru: Вспомнил, как они с Володей первый раз поцеловались, укутанные в этот самый занавес.
reading.question: What memory does the stage curtain trigger for Yurka?
options: Their first kiss, wrapped together in that same curtain
The time Volodya tore the curtain
reading.correct: Their first kiss, wrapped together in that same curtain
reading.explain: Touching the curtain, Yurka recalls how he and Volodya shared their first kiss wrapped in this very curtain.

reading.ru: Он умышленно причинял себе боль, чтобы наказать себя.
reading.question: What realization does Yurka have about why Volodya held his hand over the boiling water?
options: Volodya was deliberately hurting himself to punish himself
Volodya was testing his pain tolerance for a bet
Volodya was trying to warm his hands
Volodya didn't realize the water was hot
reading.correct: Volodya was deliberately hurting himself to punish himself
reading.explain: Yurka suddenly understands it was punishment — Volodya was deliberately hurting himself to punish himself.

reading.ru: Володя приблизился, положил руку на плечо, заставив развернуться.
reading.question: What did Volodya do to Yurka before the performance while helping him get ready?
options: He came over, put a hand on his shoulder, and turned him around to tie his scarf
He told him to calm down and left
He gave him a note with lines to remember
He handed him the pistol prop
reading.correct: He came over, put a hand on his shoulder, and turned him around to tie his scarf
reading.explain: Volodya approached, placed a hand on Yurka's shoulder, turned him around, and began tying the red knot of his scarf.

reading.ru: Пообещай, что не отведешь от меня взгляда».
reading.question: What does Yurka ask Volodya to promise before the lullaby scene?
options: That he won't look away from him
That he'll stay backstage the whole time
That he'll fix his glasses first
reading.correct: That he won't look away from him
reading.explain: Yurka asks Volodya to promise not to take his eyes off him while he plays.

reading.ru: К часу дня зал заполнился до отказа.
reading.question: How full was the hall by one o'clock, before the show started?
options: Packed, with some viewers having to sit in the aisle
Overflowing only with children, no adults
reading.correct: Packed, with some viewers having to sit in the aisle
reading.explain: The text says the hall filled to capacity, and some viewers had to sit in the aisle.

reading.ru: Уважаемые зрители, вашему вниманию представляется спектакль, посвященный юбилею нашего любимого лагеря «Ласточка» имени пионера-героя Зины Портновой.
reading.question: What did Volodya announce as he opened the performance?
options: That the play honors the camp's anniversary and pioneer-hero Zina Portnova
That the play was written by the campers themselves
That there would be a costume contest afterward
That photographs were forbidden during the show
reading.correct: That the play honors the camp's anniversary and pioneer-hero Zina Portnova
reading.explain: Volodya announces the play is dedicated to the camp's anniversary, named after pioneer-hero Zina Portnova.

reading.ru: Зина познакомилась с Фрузой Зиньковой, которую играла Ульяна, и вступила в ряды юных мстителей.
reading.question: Who did Zina meet and join forces with in the first scene?
reading.correct: Fruza Zinkova, played by Ulyana
reading.explain: In the first episode, Zina meets Fruza Zinkova, played by Ulyana, and joins the young avengers.

reading.ru: «Это крысиный яд», – уточнила она.
reading.question: What object did the committee give Zina as her assignment, disguised as something else?
options: A vial of rat poison, since nothing else was available
A grenade hidden in a book
A map hidden in a shoe
A gun hidden in a loaf of bread
reading.correct: A vial of rat poison, since nothing else was available
reading.explain: The chairperson hands Portnova a glass perfume vial, explaining it's actually rat poison since nothing else was found.

reading.ru: Небольшое полое бревно.
reading.question: What prop was supposed to be on stage as a weapons cache but was missing?
reading.correct: A hollow log
reading.explain: The text mentions a small hollow log meant to be the weapons hiding spot, which Alyosha forgot to bring out.

reading.ru: Настал звездный час пухлякосашки, которому поручили играть первого из убитых немцев.
reading.question: Whose big scene arrived as the 'first German to die' in the play?
reading.correct: Chubby Sashka's
reading.explain: The text says it was chubby Sashka's big moment, cast as the first German killed.

reading.ru: Бабушка стала хлопотать над Зиной, а маленькая Галя, обнимая её, очень реалистично заплакала и, сквозь всхлипы, произнесла тонким голосом «Зиночка, я же без тебя совсем одна останусь, в Ленинграде голод, там мама и папа».
reading.question: How did the young actresses playing Galya and the grandmother perform their emotional scene?
options: With too much laughter, ruining the mood
Not at all, since they were replaced
reading.correct: Wonderfully — Galya cried very realistically
reading.explain: The text praises the girls, saying they acted wonderfully, with Galya crying very convincingly.

reading.ru: Все водокачки были уже уничтожены советской армией, осталась лишь одна работающая станция неподалеку от Оболи.
reading.question: What was the state of the water towers by this point in the story?
options: All destroyed except one working station near Oboli
Never built in the first place
reading.correct: All destroyed except one working station near Oboli
reading.explain: The narration explains all the water towers had been destroyed by the Soviet army except one still working near Oboli.

reading.ru: Через три дня водонапорную станцию разворотила до основания.
reading.question: How long did it take the Germans to repair the water tower after the sabotage?
options: Two weeks, during which 800 trains failed to reach the front
reading.correct: Two weeks, during which 800 trains failed to reach the front
reading.explain: The text says repairs took two weeks, during which the Germans failed to send 800 trains to the front.

reading.ru: «3 августа юные мстители нанесли по врагу самый мощный удар.
reading.question: What time did the electric station explode in the play's story?
reading.explain: The narrator announces the electric station blew up into the air at 18:00.

reading.ru: А в итоге, впервые на Юркиной памяти, произнес четкую, звонкую «Р».
reading.question: What impressed Yurka about Olezhka's performance as Ilya Yazovitov?
options: He finally pronounced a clear, ringing "R" for the first time
He refused to go on stage
reading.correct: He finally pronounced a clear, ringing "R" for the first time
reading.explain: The text marvels that Olezhka, who stumbled with his speech impediment early on, ended up pronouncing a clear, ringing R for the first time ever.

reading.ru: Зина Портнова ушла в партизанский отряд имени Климента Ворошилова.
reading.question: According to the play's narration, on what date were nearly all the underground members arrested?
reading.correct: August 26th
reading.explain: The narrator states that on August 26th, the Gestapo arrested almost all the underground members and their families.

reading.ru: В памяти сразу всплыли химзавивка и огромные очки.
reading.question: What painful memories resurfaced in Yurka's mind just before his solo performance?
options: The perm and huge glasses of the exam judge, and the verdict of failure
Volodya's warning about the water tank
reading.correct: The perm and huge glasses of the exam judge, and the verdict of failure
reading.explain: The text says the memory of the frizzy perm, huge glasses, and the exam verdict flashed back into Yurka's mind.

reading.ru: Музыка заполнила всего Юрку, пробралась в самые потаенные закоулки души, разбередила, вынула оттуда все — грусть, тоску, страх, любовь.
reading.question: What did the music seem to do to Yurka as he played the lullaby?
options: It filled him completely, drawing out grief, longing, fear, and love
It made him forget the notes entirely
It put the whole audience to sleep
It reminded him only of his mother
reading.correct: It filled him completely, drawing out grief, longing, fear, and love
reading.explain: The text says the music filled Yurka entirely, pulling out grief, longing, fear, and love from deep inside him.

reading.ru: «Спасибо!» – выдохнул Володя.
reading.question: What single word did Volodya breathe out while embracing Yurka backstage after the lullaby?
reading.correct: "Thank you"
reading.explain: Volodya breathes out "Spasibo!" (Thank you!) while hugging Yurka right after his performance.

reading.ru: 5 ноября в деревне Боровуха под Полоцком расстреляли Евгения Язовитова и Николая Алексеева.
reading.question: According to the play's narration, who was executed on November 5th in the village of Borovukha?
reading.correct: Yevgeny Yazovitov and Nikolai Alekseev
reading.explain: The narrator states that on November 5th, in the village of Borovukha near Polotsk, Yevgeny Yazovitov and Nikolai Alekseev were shot.

reading.ru: Слепая, она нацарапала гвоздиком на стене своей камеры рисунок сердца, а над ним девочка с косичками и надпись «Приговорена к расстрелу».
reading.question: What did the blind, tortured Zina scratch onto her cell wall before her execution, according to the narration?
options: A heart, a girl with braids, and the words "Sentenced to be shot"
A map of the escape route
reading.correct: A heart, a girl with braids, and the words "Sentenced to be shot"
reading.explain: The narration says blind Zina scratched a heart, a girl with braids above it, and the words "Sentenced to be shot" onto her cell wall.

reading.ru: Показалось, что ваша портнова не ушла к партизанам, а позорно сбежала, предав товарищей.
reading.question: What criticism did Olga Leonidovna give after praising the play?
options: That Portnova's exit looked like a shameful desertion rather than joining the partisans
That the music was too loud
That the actors spoke too quietly
reading.correct: That Portnova's exit looked like a shameful desertion rather than joining the partisans
reading.explain: Olga Leonidovna says it looked as though their Portnova shamefully fled rather than joining the partisans, betraying her comrades.

reading.ru: «Дружба с Володей влияет на тебя положительно».
reading.question: What comment does Olga Leonidovna make about Yurka's improvement this year?
options: That his friendship with Volodya is influencing him positively
That he should be the new director next year
That he still needs to try harder
That his piano skills are unimpressive
reading.correct: That his friendship with Volodya is influencing him positively
reading.explain: Olga Leonidovna remarks that Konev's friendship with Volodya is having a positive influence on him.

reading.ru: Три, два, один!» – и щелкнул камерой.
reading.question: What did Pal Sanych count down before taking the group photo?
reading.correct: "Three, two, one!"
reading.explain: The chapter ends with Pal Sanych counting "Three, two, one!" and clicking the camera.
